# Design DNA in Claude apps (web, desktop, mobile)

<!-- generated by python install.py docs from hosts/registry/claude-apps.json -->

## Install

### Custom skill upload (Free, Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise; code execution on)

Method: upload a zip. Capability: **Hosted code sandbox**. The scripts run in the vendor's container. Which packages and browsers it has is not documented for this skill and was not tested; scripts/capabilities.py reports it at the start of a chat. Files do not outlive the sandbox, so download exported bundles.

1. Turn on code execution in Claude's settings.
2. Open Customize, then Skills, and select Upload a skill.
3. Choose design-dna-claude-skill.zip. It holds one top-level folder, reverse-design/.
4. Team and Enterprise owners can provision the skill for the whole organization instead.

Package: [design-dna-claude-skill.zip](https://github.com/OzyAcc/design-dna/releases/latest/download/design-dna-claude-skill.zip) (or `python install.py package --target claude-skill`). It is small by design, roughly 130 KB: SKILL.md, the engine's Python scripts, references and schemas. Tests and fonts are not included (you supply the fonts a design uses). A file of a few bytes is a failed download.

## Prerequisites

- Any Claude plan with code execution turned on

## Try it

Attach a poster or social post and ask: *Scan this design with Design DNA and save it as "Spring Launch".* Then: *Change only the headline to "Made for every day" and keep everything else.*
